command: uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/speed-check run --task C9 --head HEAD --scratch $SCRATCH

method.text: harness/bench.md, 'Speed check of a change': the S2 method (the CI image in docker, one container, serial, no network, no other load; the full profile; the tools run in turn for each repeat). The start and parse benchmarks of sqlfluff, sqll, sqll-base, sqruff.
method.load_rule: the session starts when the 1-minute load average is below 0.3; after it, the 5-minute load average must be at most 1.5

slowdowns.formula: ratio = HEAD / BASE of the median wall time and of the median CPU time of a benchmark. A metric is slower if its ratio is more than 1 + the noise limit (compare.Noise; harness/bench.md, 'Slowdowns'); a benchmark is slower if a metric is slower. failure: HEAD is not valid.

sqruff.rule: G3.5: HEAD is not slower than sqruff on any pair and is faster on the total of the pairs
sqruff.ratio: head_ratio = the median wall time of HEAD / that of sqruff

sqlfluff.rule: G3.4: HEAD is faster than sqlfluff on each pair
sqlfluff.ratio: head_ratio = the median wall time of HEAD / that of sqlfluff
